rules: Joint symmetric minP rank of local,spatial-prior and fixed-mixture likelihood statistics. Smallest component p selects location,local then spatial on ties. Compare original MAP location versus unweighted maximum component likelihood when mixture is selected. Original numerator weights/presence statistics unchanged;no ground truth in either selector.
scope: New CLOSED development hypotheses after failed methods;not prospective efficacy or novelty proof. Standard joint resampling/omnibus and marginal-test/profile-localization ideas. Any promotion needs fresh independently frozen data.
